# Agent card

Fetch only what you need:

```sh
nanoc --describe syntax              # small syntax/phase card
nanoc --describe replace             # one builtin
nanoc --describe builtins            # complete signatures
nanoc unit.nc --check --diagnostics json
nanoc unit.nc -o unit.c --diagnostics json
cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic-errors unit.c -o unit
```

- Checks validate expansion, not C/C++ types/linking/runtime. Then compile and test.
- `--check` never writes generated code and rejects BT host effects. Normal builds execute BT effects; `--no-effects` disables them.
- Success check JSON: schemaVersion, ok, file, validation, language, generatedBytes, symbols, passes, logs, diagnostics.
- Errors: one JSON object on stderr, nonzero exit. Diagnostics contain code, file, line, message, trace. Codes: NC_SYNTAX, NC_LIMIT, NC_INPUT. Schema v1 is additive.
- Use `@f add(int a,b) int = a+b` or an indented final expression; no arrows/braces/block colons/semicolons.
- CT/macros generate/edit code; BT adds host files/commands. `rewrite` converges on unchanged text; `again` forces a pass; `--max-passes 0 --max-steps 0` removes count limits.
- Preserve raw C/C++ for unsupported declarators. Assembly: `--describe asm`.
